## Description {#details}

<p>Diagnostic trace output channel for µOS++ applications.</p>


<p>The <b>µOS++ Tracing Infrastructure</b> library facilitates the output of trace messages, a widely utilised diagnostic technique during debugging. A notable example is the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">trace::printf()</span> function.</p>


<p>The core implementation is developed in C++, complemented by a minimal C wrapper layer.</p>


<p>The functions are categorised into three distinct groups:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Functions that must be implemented by the user to define the channel for transmitting trace messages from the target.</li>
<li>Core tracing functions.</li>
<li>Auxiliary utility functions.</li>
</ul>
